description: Render one or more DGMO diagrams and open an HTML preview in the browser. Supports theme toggle and optional source display. For DGMO syntax call get_language_reference (e.g. color a label with a trailing color name: "Sales red").

diagrams.description: One or more diagrams to preview

dgmo.description: DGMO diagram markup. Color a label by appending a lowercase color name as the trailing token (e.g. "Sales red"); capitalize ("Red") to use a color word as literal text.

include_source.description: Show DGMO source in collapsible blocks

name: preview_diagram
